chapter.title: PHP Using and Creating Components with Composer

payload.markdown: Although you cannot use Composer to install system-wide packages, you can specify system-wide requirements, so that your package will only install in a system which is ready for it. A platform package is specified with a single key, though in a couple of cases the key is further broken down by type, using a dash. I list the available types in Table 16-2.

Error Handling: Responding to PHP errors and warnings without letting the request die.
Error Patterns: Repeatable strategies: fail fast, wrap and rethrow, aggregate and report.
Include & Require: Loading PHP files at runtime; require_once guards against re-declaration.
Nullable Types: Types that explicitly allow null, written as ?
Primitive Types: int, float, string and bool: PHP's scalar building blocks.
Return Types: The declared type of a function's return value.
